_about: The well room (the drowned body in the well; the mine's way down). Room Review round 23 (2026-10-10, Josh): WELLROOM/1 the well's water as the spa's, scaled to the small pool -- the surface is the part 'death' (NIBODYBASE, y -35, a hexagon x 7..78, z -100..-39), which is not named for water, so 'water.parts' marks it; WELLROOM/2 its light rippling on the ceiling (85.5, 120 above it) and the pipes; WELLROOM/3 the painted darkness made real in a black volumetric fog (as CORICORI); WELLROOM/4 a torch; WELLROOM/5-6 two faint hazy teal lights for the well's glow.

lights.name: torch on the west wall
lights._note: Room Review WELLROOM/4: on WELL_WALL05 at Josh's mark (-161.85, 10.86, -19.84), 15 units out along the wall's normal; as every torch

lights.name: teal glow of the well (south-west wall)
lights._note: Room Review WELLROOM/5: the well's glow, a hazy teal like the spa's water (its water mist #7FE6DA, a little deeper), not too bright; on WELL_WALL02 at Josh's mark (-6.96, -18.04, -117.65), 15 units out; no graphic, no flicker. air = it shows in the dark air (hazy)

lights.name: teal glow of the well (east wall)
lights._note: Room Review WELLROOM/6: another, fainter, same teal; on WELL_WALL03 at Josh's mark (81.43, -4.12, -7.04), 15 units out

lights.name: dust in the air
lights._note: Room Review WELLROOM/7 (round 24, Josh: 'Dust particles in this room as well'): the floating, lit specks CORICORI has in its light shaft. Floating dust only comes with a spotlight's cone, so this is a spotlight with NO light (power 0, no shadow, no air, no bounce) -- a wide cone from under the ceiling (y 80; it is at 85 here) over Josh's mark on the well floor (-47.35, -41.45, -26.59), down to the floor: about 170 units round at the floor

embers._note: the torch's flame is the shader flame; no ember particles (as the other rooms)

gi._about: Bounced light, as the other rooms; ambient 0.6 (MINEMAZE's gentler cut): the painted darkness already darkens the room

volume._about: As CORICORI (WELLROOM/3): black air that absorbs with distance, lit by the lights as they pass; paint = thicker black where the ORIGINAL art is painted dark.

artLight._about: WELLROOM/3 (Josh: dark mist like the black areas drawn on the textures): as MINEHEAD -- the ORIGINAL art's painted light and shade, per texel, shades the room level and the bounce (the placed lights untouched), so the painted black reads as real darkness; on top of the black painted-darkness fog, which here lies mostly along the walls.

water._about: WELLROOM/1-2: SPAROOM's water (same glow colour, glow, shine, glints) scaled to a pool about 70 units across instead of 600: one lamp under the middle, finer ripples and caustic web; the caustics' height 200 puts the ceiling 120 up at 55% (the light also spreads height/2 = 100 units past the pool's edge, so the three walls round the well and its pipes take it). parts = which part IS the water (its material is not named for it).

ghost._about: Josh, 2026-10-11: Niamh, the floating lady, 'more ethereal ... look like a ghost and not a bunch of polygons' -- drawn by the card as glowing smoke (GpuRaster.DrawGhost): thin and bright at her outline, fuller through her body, fading from her waist into nothing below, smoke rising through her, a soft glow so no polygon edge shows, the room wobbling behind her, wisps shed from her hem, ribbons and hands, and a dim teal light of her own. Sizes are shares of her height. -NoGhost draws her solid.
ghost._textureColour: Josh, 2026-10-11: 'add back her textures but leave the new effects' -- her own painted colours inside the glow, at full detail (0 = the glow's teal with her art's light and shade only)
